notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone.[/h2][h2]Update 5A is here and here are some changes:[/h2][p][/p][p]-Individual Gibs added for every enemy, including bosses.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/4ccdb4dd89e212ecb37ab51c6ee9ecde5f0fcd60.gif"][/img][/p][p]-Skill Menu changed and some SFX added. The artworks from this menu is removed, I'm planing add new artworks in the future.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/55f13ba01aabdad5946675e2fdf76af9351b8417.jpg"][/img][/p][p]-New Skill "[b]Tax Evader[/b]" added. With this you can %40 more BP gain.[/p][p]-Shotgun's skill "Behive" now has better SFX.[/p][p]-New Hook Attack for Deagle added. [/p][p]-New Music for E1M2 is added, made by Revosider, thanks.[/p][p]-This section in E2M3 is changed. Now it's much larger.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/37def2c13e7a6cffe11a88f57e2e4b8a73a0007b.png"][/img][b]-E2M4 is added. [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132304/35571927a2bb3e36b1728525e18b42999997f632.png"][/img][/p][p]-New Cenk (Player) model and Texture is added.[/p][p]-Custom Skin is added. Go to the game files and find the "mods" folder there should be skin.png file, you can change it to however you like. Currently his head is excluded from the texture.[/p][p]-Save file location has changed. Instead of "Cenk The Chopper/Cenk The Chopper_Data/save" it just uses "Cenk The Chopper/save" directory. Game will still read the old save files, however while writing new ones it'll write them into new directory, and read the new files if they exist.[/p][p]

Note: Some of these changes are only accesable in the main game, and not in playtest. Like New Maps or Shotgun. But I still wanted to share them as progress.[/p]

notes.title: Update 4g: Two New Maps, Hit sounds, New Music, Camera Lock System
notes.notes:
It has been a while since the last update. So, sorry about that.
Here's the changes for Update 4g:

-Added 2 new maps: E1M4 and E1M5.

-Added Camera lock system. You can either soft lock, which only looks at the selected enemy one; or full lock with allways look at the selected enemy.

-E1M1 start area has changed, and camera tutorial added.

-E1M3 music has changed.

-Hit sound added for every weapon. Previously only the Sickles normal and charged attack has it.

-Taking damage sound volume increased.

-Vignette effect when taking damage has increased.

-With Sickles, attacking while sliding will end up as charged attack with special animation.

notes.title: Update 3a: new Weapon Shotgun, bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes and Changes:[/b]


-Hitstop [list]
[*]    -Damage Limit added for player triggering hitstop, if player takes little damage the Hitstop won't trigger.
[*]    -Flykick (a.k.a. Slide Jump kick) now triggers Hitstop.
[/list]
-Enemy changes:
[list]
[*] -Lutum (The Zombie man), is now have longer animation which longer parry window for player and now has shorter wait time before the attack animation.
[*] -Canis (The fire wolf), now has longer wait time between attacks.
[*] -Enemies timer between attacks are slightly randomized now, so they don't look like synchronized in group.
[/list]
-Smash Attack (aka the Stomp) is changed.
   [list]
[*] -Now there 2 stage of Stomps. 
[*]    -Tabing and releasing the Slide button (CTRL), Cenk will do the lite Stomp, which doesn't deal damage or launch the light weight enemies, just for landing fast.
[*]    -Holding the Slide button (CTRL), Cenk will do the heavy Stomp, which deals damage and launches the light weigth enemies. 
[*]    -While holding Cenk flips in the air and charges, you start falling once you release or change is complate
[/list]
-Shotgun added:
   [list]
[*] -Normally you should get the shotgun by playing the game and encountering it. Well.. that level isn't ready, so instead go to the Extras>Weapons tab, there just press the Shotgun button and now you get the shotgun. Kinda like Cheat.
[*]    -Right now, Shotgun has both Weapon skill and Ultimate Skill that you can buy from the Skill station. There's not art for them yet.
[/list]

If you have any feedbacks about these changes, please let me know from the Steam Forum.

One last thing, Game is now running on the Unity 6. I upgraded for some features that improves the development. I fixed some bugs and glitches that appears after upgrading but If you see any bug or glitch mostly visual, please let me know as well.

notes.title: Update 2a
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Here's the changes on new Update 2a:

-E1M2 improved visually
-E1M1 improved visually
-In the Sickle's Ult skill, Cenk now uses Scythe for a slash, that disappears after
-In the Sickle's Boomerang skill; throw animation changed, default boomerang speed slightly increased and dash when throwing disabled when on the ground 
-In the Deagle's Deflector skill, now each deflected shot will play an sfx
-In the Deagle Ult skill, the reverse effect change slightly
-Bug fixed, where replaying and getting the same rank and same or worse stats, causes them to override as 0
-In the Parry, while in the air Cenk will have a different animation
-Hit stop added, right now only Sickles melee attacks uses it
